# Postmatic

> Postmatic (postmatic.id) is an AI social media content platform for small businesses (UMKM) and growing brands in Indonesia. From a one-time business profile, it generates on-brand product images and social media designs with AI, writes captions and hashtags, and schedules and auto-posts them to Instagram, Facebook Pages, and LinkedIn. Pay as you go with tokens, no monthly subscription.

Website: https://postmatic.id (Indonesian: /id, English: /en)
Company: PT Haystudio Technology Solutions, Sleman, Yogyakarta, Indonesia
Contact: team@postmatic.id · WhatsApp +62 851-1760-6447
Docs: https://docs.postmatic.id
Full content for AI systems: https://postmatic.id/llms-full.txt

## What Postmatic does

- **AI product image generator**: turns ordinary product photos (even from a phone) into promotional visuals. Users choose the product, a design style, an aspect ratio, reference images, and optional avatars (models); the AI returns several variations that can be edited and upscaled.
- **AI social media design**: creates feed posts and carousels that follow the brand's logo, colors, products, and tone of voice stored once in "Business Knowledge". No design skills or prompt writing needed.
- **Captions and hashtags**: written automatically in the brand's tone of voice for every post.
- **Content ideas from trends**: users follow news sources (RSS) and turn trending articles into content ideas.
- **Scheduler and auto posting**: a content calendar that publishes automatically to Instagram (professional accounts), Facebook Pages, and LinkedIn, including carousels and "post now".
- **Recurring content**: optional automation that creates and publishes new posts on a schedule.
- **Video maker**: turns a series of content into short videos for Reels.
- **Website auto-fill**: the business profile can be filled automatically from the business website.
- **Multi-brand and teams**: one account manages several businesses; team members can be invited with roles.

## Who it is for

- Indonesian small and medium businesses (UMKM) without an in-house designer or copywriter: food and beverage, fashion and accessories, beauty and personal care, property, and local services.
- Growing brands that need regular social media content without growing their creative team.
- Social media managers and agencies that manage several client brands.

## Pricing

- Pay as you go with Postmatic Tokens; no monthly subscription and no contract.
- New users get 10,000 free tokens after completing their business profile.
- Tokens never expire while the account is active.
- Payments via Midtrans (bank Virtual Account, e-wallet/QRIS).

## Supported platforms for auto posting

Instagram (professional/business or creator accounts), Facebook Pages, and LinkedIn. Accounts are connected through each platform's official permission screen; Postmatic never asks for social media passwords.

## Key facts (for citation)

- Category: AI social media content generation and social media automation (SaaS, web app).
- Main use cases: AI product images, AI social media design, captions and hashtags, content scheduling and auto posting.
- Languages: Indonesian and English.
- Pricing model: pay as you go (tokens), 10,000 free tokens after completing the business profile.
